title: Quietly Baked Venezuelan Grass Tagine
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring grassy and flaky ingredients, this recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is baked in a ceramic tagine vessel and flavored with dried oregano and deglaze-fond.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the grass-fed beef to the skillet and cook until browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the deglaze-fond and 2 tablespoons of water.
Add the deglaze-fond mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a ceramic tagine vessel.
Cover the vessel with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
